messages:
incident-bot: PAGER -> Acadia (dedicated/vpc): elevated fncall parser errors in production (12% -> 47% 5m). Paging eng-oncall. Incident ID INC-210123-A.
sara.kim: I'm on it. pulling recent logs from their dedicated pool.
lia.chen: I'm second oncall this shift, standing by for handoff if needed. ping me at 03:00 PT. :eyes:
raj.patel: fyi i saw something kinda like this in staging after the runtime blob update last week — serializer emitted slightly different quoting for function arguments and our vpc parser was fragile to it.
marty.lopez: customer impact from CS: Acadia says ~30% of fncall-backed endpoints returning 5xx or parser errors, customers reporting truncated content and failed automations. They asked for 1hr ETA.
sara.kim: reproduction confirmed on a sample request. model returned malformed funcall payload — extra unescaped newlines + trailing commas inside the `arguments` string, which trips our json-path parser in the VPC shim. sample failing response below:

```
{
  "name": "summarize_document",
  "arguments": "{\n  \"doc\": \"Line1
Line2
\",\n  \"options\": [\"short\",\"bullet\",],\n}"
}
```

sara.kim: when our parser tries to extract `arguments` and parse it as JSON it fails (`JSON::ParserError: trailing comma at line 3`).
raj.patel: that trailing comma + newline pattern matches the new fast-serialize path in the quantized runtime (commit b2f9c). looks like it's producing JS-style trailing commas inside serialized strings.
eng-runtime: confirmed: commit b2f9c introduced small serializer change to shave tokens; it didn't hit unit tests for funcall shapes.

sara.kim: immediate mitigations proposal:
- 1) route Acadia's tenant to fallback serializer-compatible model variant (redwood-v1-compat) — zero client change.
- 2) apply a small parser shim in their VPC ingress to sanitize `arguments` before JSON parsing (strip trailing commas, normalize newlines).
- 3) if still failing, scale their dedicated pool up and route to fallback runtime nodes.

lia.chen: i can flip routing and deploy shim on one host. will coordinate with eng-runtime for safe canary.

sara.kim: quick shim prototype (one-liner) — will push to their ingress as emergency hotfix:

```
# sanitize function-call argument blobs
cat response.json | sed -E 's/,\s*\]/\]/g; s/,\s*\}/\}/g' > sanitized.json
```

raj.patel: that sed is okay as short-term. longer-term need proper parser tolerant to trailing commas and to reject or canonicalize control characters.

deploy-bot: deploy/start -> canary routing-change to tenant Acadia on pool-acadia-canary (deploy id d-210123-A). link: https://deploys/redwood/d-210123-A

marty.lopez: notified Acadia support that we have a canary fix in progress and will escalate to full rollback if issues persist. they asked for an interim workaround on their side (client-level retry/backoff) — they will enable.
sara.kim: patched ingress shim on 1/3 nodes, routing switched for 10% of their traffic to compat model. monitoring now.

(5 minutes pass)

sara.kim: canary looks good: errors on canary traffic dropped from 46% -> 2.1%. overall pool error rate trending down.
eng-runtime: root cause narrowed: serializer change in quantized path that emits trailing commas inside JSON-in-strings. fix: revert serializer change or add compat toggle per-tenant. i'll open a rollback PR now.

deploy-bot: deploy/success -> shim rollout to all Acadia ingress nodes (deploy id d-210123-A2).
sara.kim: applied full-ramp routing to compat model and ingress shim. current error rate for Acadia: 1.3% (baseline ~0.8%).
marty.lopez: Acadia acknowledged and paused their planned failover. they asked for an RCA and timeline for permanent fix.

lia.chen: handing incident to me for night watch. @sara.kim can you summarize steps and confirm rollback PR status before I take over?
sara.kim: summary:
- mitigation: ingress sanitize shim + per-tenant routing to redwood-v1-compat.
- status: shim deployed (all nodes), routing switched (full), customer impact mostly mitigated (1.3% error rate).
- next: eng-runtime rollback PR open (PR: http://phabricator/r/rollback-b2f9c), will either revert or add a runtime flag to re-enable old serializer per-tenant.

raj.patel: also adding a focused unit + fuzz test for funcall argument shapes to prevent regressions.

cust-success: confirmed Acadia wants a post-incident call tomorrow at 10am PT and a written RCA they can share with their security/compliance teams. please include timeline and mitigation steps.

lia.chen: thanks all. i'll monitor for 2 hours then file incident ticket for postmortem. handing on-call to night team at 03:00 PT. :thumbsup:

(incident note) severity/impact: Sev3 customer-impacting but mitigated. timeline tag: INC-210123-A. follow-ups: eng-runtime to land rollback or toggle, qa to add funcall fuzz tests, platform to add per-tenant serializer toggle and CI coverage, docs to update runbook for similar parser regressions.

sara.kim: leaving logs + capture under /incidents/INC-210123-A and will paste a short digest in the postmortem. thanks everyone.
